description: Interviews the owner, one topic at a time, and writes `.claude/rules/ship.md` — the ordered string of shipping steps (push, open a pull request, review rounds, merge, release, and whatever the contracts directory offers) that `/ship-build` runs. Offers the most common string first so accepting it is one answer, asks each offered step's own parameters, and, on the owner's yes, installs the workflow that resumes a parked run when a reviewer approves. Owner-invoked only — no command or agent may reach it.
